Flagship

Sley

Flagship

Sley

A machine-native programming language for AI agents. A Sley program is a typed, content-addressed semantic graph rather than source text. Agents read it through bounded queries and change it with typed mutations, and a deterministic kernel checks every change before an atomic commit.

reprieveMakes Super+W on Omarchy hide the window instead of killing it, so one keystroke brings it back exactly as it was omarchy-hotbarOmarchy bar plugin with fixed app slots, filesystem Places, and one bounded Running drawer omarchy-grabbarMouse-driven window controls for Omarchy: minimize, maximize, close, and move, and every minimized window keeps a way back node-healthcheckOne Bash script that runs Linux host health checks with JSON output, 0/1/2 exit codes, and multi-node SSH aggregation service-cartographerBuilds a read-only keep, review, and retire matrix for services, cron jobs, wrappers, repos, and env-file metadata devcapScans a machine for installed developer tools and reports versions, paths, and what is missing as text, JSON, or Markdown sqlite-checkpointCLI and Python library for SQLite WAL checkpoints, online backups, and snapshots, with no dependencies beyond the standard library cooldown-guardSQLite-backed cooldown and retry gate that enforces minimum intervals for cron jobs, recurring commands, and repair loops atomic-json-storeAtomic, cross-process locked, schema-versioned JSON persistence for Python with zero dependencies memory-quality-gateScores agent memory candidates with deterministic heuristics, not an LLM judge, before they reach long-term storage voiceopsFull-duplex Discord voice loop for agent gateways
